{{Quote|Xesh, once a Force Hound and slave to the Rakata, says that his former masters are also called "the Builders" by many in the galaxy. We have known nothing but destruction.|Daegen Lok|<ref name="DOTJ 11" />}}
Around [[25,793 BBY]], the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] of the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] [[Species/Legends|species]] '''invaded''' the [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]]. Under the command of [[Predor]] [[Skal'nas]], who sought the [[Infinity Gate]] rumored to be located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], the Infinite Empire laid waste to the [[Settled Worlds]], but met resistance in the allied [[Je'daii Order]] and the forces of the Settled Worlds.

==The invasion==
Around [[25,793 BBY]], the forces of the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] invaded the [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]]. Skal'nas sought to reverse his [[Species/Legends|species's]] gradual loss of control over [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by acquiring the [[Infinity Gate]] said to exist on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], and his forces [[Attack on Fury Station|attacked]] the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Fury Station]] on the edges of the system before [[Capture of Obri|capturing]] [[Capture of Mawr|both]] of the gas giants [[Obri]] and [[Mawr]]. The Rakata and their [[Flesh Raider]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] [[First battle of Tython|attacked]] Tython, but were repelled by the [[Je'daii Order]]; the Infinite Empire fell back to the forest world of [[Ska Gora]] and [[Fall of Ska Gora|conquered]] it before establishing their [[Rakatan Base Prime|main command post]] there. By the end of the first year, the Je'daii had allied themselves with the forces of the [[Settled Worlds]], placing [[Je'daii Master]] [[Rajivari]] in command of the joint forces. The Order also constructed [[Forcesaber]]s, the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] weapons of the Rakata, and armed themselves with the weapons as they recalled the insane [[Daegen Lok]] to lead them in battle as Lok had foreseen.<ref name="DOTJ 11" /> Ultimately the War ended in a Je'daii victory; with Skal'nas's fall most of the Rakata turned on each other and fled, leaving behind a large degree of slaves.<ref name="DOTJ 15">[[Dawn of the Jedi: Force War 5|''Dawn of the Jedi: Force War'' 5]]</ref>
